summary: Master corporate diplomacy and stakeholder strategy with practical tools, stakeholder maps, issue briefs, and executive reporting. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Corporate diplomacy and stakeholder strategy help professionals align executive priorities with stakeholder relationships and reputation. For corporate affairs, public affairs, ESG, communications, and policy professionals, the course offers a structured approach to turning fragmented input into engagement plans and executive-ready reporting. Participants practice stakeholder mapping and issue prioritization, build message maps, and prepare issue response playbooks.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work with stakeholder pressure, executive messaging, or external relationships and need a more disciplined approach to corporate diplomacy and stakeholder strategy. It also suits adjacent professionals who coordinate ESG, communications, public affairs, or policy engagement and must turn fragmented inputs into usable plans.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, note-taking capability, and access to any non-confidential stakeholder lists, issue logs, or recent briefing materials you can safely use in exercises. Familiarity with corporate affairs, public affairs, communications, ESG, or government relations processes is recommended. The course uses practical templates and scenario work, so no programming or advanced analytics background is required.
